name: PRO-LAD
summary: A rare lysergamide that is slightly less potent than LSD with a shorter duration of action.

pharmacology.text: PRO-LAD shows affinity for serotonin receptors, including for the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, and 5-HT2C receptors. It acts as a partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor similarly to LSD. The drug fully substitutes for LSD in rodent drug discrimination tests and with about the same or slightly greater potency than LSD itself. On the other hand, it was about 2- to 3-fold less potent than ETH-LAD or AL-LAD.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: PRO-LAD was first investigated by Andrew J. Hoffman and David E. Nichols in 1984 as part of a series of LSD analogs. It has been sold on the online research chemical market alongside lysergamides like 1P-LSD and AL-LAD as a legal, grey-market alternative to LSD.

summaryZh: PRO-LAD是一種有機化合物，化學式為C22H29N3O，為迷幻藥物麥角酸二乙醯胺的同系物，最早由亞歷山大·舒爾金在其著作《TiHKAL：延續》中提出。
summaryZhHans: PRO-LAD是一种有机化合物，化学式为C22H29N3O，为迷幻药物麦角酸二乙酰胺的同系物，最早由亚历山大·舒尔金在其著作《TiHKAL：延续》中提出。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of this kind can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, raised heart rate and blood pressure, and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類迷幻藥可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳和血壓上升以及驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类迷幻药可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳和血压上升以及惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: PRO-LAD is LSD with the methyl group on one of its nitrogen atoms swapped for a longer propyl group. Alexander Shulgin described it in TiHKAL.
fact.zh: PRO-LAD 是把 LSD 其中一個氮原子上的甲基換成較長的丙基。Alexander Shulgin 在《TiHKAL》中描述過它。
fact.zhHans: PRO-LAD 是把 LSD 其中一个氮原子上的甲基换成较长的丙基。Alexander Shulgin 在《TiHKAL》中描述过它。
